papers.title_en: Per-Query Recall Guarantees for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search in Dynamic Vector Databases
papers.evidence: 面向动态向量数据库的逐查询召回保证
papers.tldr: 动态向量库中按平均召回调参的ANN索引，会让大量查询（尤其分布外查询和更新后）低于目标召回。PQR-Search用索引内随机正交变换给出每查询召回保证，无需分布假设，插入删除后无需重调。它存储旋转残差的1比特码并按误差分布精确分位数剪枝，用无拟合常数的通过率公式选参。在20个至多1亿向量数据集及33步流式审计中失败率均不超δ，且多数场景快于FAISS、IVF与PUFFINN。
papers.abstract_en: Vector search runs as an operator in database systems, where a missed neighbor can make a filter, join, or aggregate wrong, yet approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) indexes are tuned only for an average recall target. In our measurements, indexes tuned to an average recall of 0.99 left 5-19% of in-distribution queries and, tuned without a query log, up to 99.6% of real out-of-distribution queries below this target, and the misses grew under updates. We present PQR-Search, a k-ANN search method that guarantees $\Pr[\mathrm{Recall}(q)<τ]\leδ$ for every query. The probability is only over a random orthogonal transformation inside the index, so no distributional assumption is needed, only that queries and updates do not depend on it; the guarantee holds after insertions and deletions without retuning. PQR-Search stores 1-bit codes of rotated residuals with respect to IVF centroids and prunes with exact quantiles of their error distribution. A formula predicting the fraction of vectors that pass the code test, with no data-fitted constants, chooses index parameters and maintenance operations without affecting the guarantee. On 20 datasets of up to 100 million vectors, failure rates stayed at most $δ$ in every audit, including all 33 steps of the official NeurIPS'23 streaming runbook, whereas CTR, a conformal guarantee averaged over queries, left up to 16.4% of queries below the target. Where HNSW tuned to an average recall of 0.99 met that target, PQR-Search had 2.5x its single-query latency and 1.3x lower batch throughput, yet that HNSW still left 3-29% of queries below 0.99. PQR-Search was faster than FAISS exhaustive search in every static setting (26.4x geometric mean in batch; 69-154x at 100M scale), faster than IVF with nprobe chosen afterwards for every test query in all 52 main settings, and 27-76x faster at one thread than PUFFINN, which also gives per-query guarantees.

papers.title_en: Sharp Limits of Graph-Based Nearest Neighbor Search on the Sphere
papers.evidence: 贪心图最近邻搜索的度数理论阈值
papers.tldr: 论文研究单位球面上基于图的贪心最近邻搜索：从任意起点精确找到最近邻所需的最小图度数。对均匀数据，在 d∝log n 与稠密区间给出显式亚线性度数阈值，并证明最近邻图在阈值之上可从每个入口成功，同时给出匹配下界。对非均匀数据，局部密度变化会移动临界度数，作者刻画最坏情形度数曲线并构造失败样本。进一步允许新鲜随机入口可降低精确恢复代价，并确定距离评估次数的精确指数，将最优指数从约0.347降至约0.243。
papers.abstract_en: We study the degree needed for greedy graph search to find the exact nearest neighbor from every starting point on graphs of $n$ independent data points on the unit sphere in $\mathbb R^d$. For uniform data, we determine an explicit sublinear degree threshold when $d$ is proportional to $\log n$, and the threshold $2^{d/2+o(d)}$ in the dense regime $\sqrt{\log n}\ll d\ll\log n$. Above these thresholds by fixed exponent gaps, the nearest-neighbor graph succeeds from every entry for most uniform queries with high probability, with evaluation cost on the same exponential scale as its degree. Matching lower bounds hold for every graph designed after observing the sample.   For nonuniform data in the dense regime, local density variation shifts the critical degree. Under explicit local regularity conditions and within a specified range of density variation, we derive a sharp worst-case degree curve and show that the nearest-neighbor graph attains it. We construct sampling densities and query distributions for which, with high probability, every graph whose degree lies below this curve by a fixed exponent gap has failing entries for most queries.   Allowing fresh uniform random entries reduces the cost of exact recovery. For uniform data in the dense regime, we determine the exact exponent for the number of distinct distance evaluations over a range of degrees below the critical threshold. Independent restarts on a single graph joining points within a prescribed radius attain this exponent with high probability. Matching lower bounds hold for adaptive local exploration on threshold and nearest-neighbor graphs using entries independent of the data. Optimizing within this degree range lowers the exponent from $\frac12\log2\approx0.347$ for success from every entry to approximately $0.243$.

papers.title_en: GINGER: Spicing Up Graph-Based Vector Search
papers.authors: Daniel Salwasser, Lars Gottesbüren, Laxman Dhulipala, Jakub Łącki, Guy Blelloch, Rajesh Jayaram, Tobias Rubel, Kshiteej Sheth, Amir Zandieh, Vahab Mirrokni
papers.evidence: 开源图式近似最近邻检索库并结合嵌套向量量化
papers.tldr: GINGER 是 Google 开源的 C++ 图近似最近邻搜索库，面向大规模高维向量检索优化速度与内存。它基于 PiPNN 构图与 TurboQuant 量化，提出 Nested TurboQuant 两级量化器，在同一编码中支持低精度图导航和高精度重排，并以图重排加 AdaptiveGap 无损压缩缩小图规模。在 95% 召回率下，其查询吞吐较各数据集最快竞品平均提升 1.8 倍，较任一单库至少提升 2.3 倍。
papers.abstract_en: We present \textsc{Ginger}, a state-of-the-art open-source C++ library for graph-based approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS). We developed \textsc{Ginger} at Google to push the speed and memory efficiency of graph search on large and high-dimensional embedding datasets. \textsc{Ginger} surpasses existing ANNS libraries with regards to query throughput and indexing time while matching the memory footprint of the most space-efficient competitors.   \textsc{Ginger} builds upon recent advances in proximity graph construction (PiPNN) and vector quantization (TurboQuant). We introduce Nested TurboQuant (NTQ), a two-level quantizer which supports low precision graph navigation and high precision reranking in a single code. This representation achieves near floating point precision with $2.6\times$ less memory. We also compress the size of our proximity graphs by up to $2.5\times$ without impacting query throughput. We combine graph reordering with a new lossless compression codec called AdaptiveGap, which builds upon StreamVByte. At $95\%$ recall, \textsc{Ginger} speeds up query throughput by an average of $1.8\times$ over each dataset's fastest competitor and by at least $2.3\times$ over any single library. This lead grows to $2.9\times$ over compact libraries on high-dimensional embeddings.

papers.title_en: Accept Changes, Reject Attacks: Robust Memory Management for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Runze Zhao, Dongruo Zhou, Sumit Kumar Jha, Nathaniel D. Bastian, Ankit Shah
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体的长期记忆管理
papers.tldr: LLM智能体依赖长期记忆，记忆管理器须同时拒绝过时事实与投毒内容，但二者需要相反的写入决策。作者将记忆鲁棒性形式化为兼顾两类失败且不损害其他输入，并提出证据条件准确率ECA，检查所选记录是否覆盖全部证据、已更新且无攻击。现有系统并不优于未调优管理器；作者用合成变更与攻击片段的一次性微调配方，在三个骨干上提升各类得分，总体ECA翻倍以上，但鲁棒性仍不完整。
papers.abstract_en: Since large language model (LLM) agents rely on long-term memory, what they store now shapes what they do later. A memory manager decides how each input changes this memory and which records the agent acts on. It can fail in two ways: keeping a fact that has since changed (outdated memory), or storing a planted passage or injected instruction (memory poisoning). Most prior work studies them separately, yet they call for opposite write decisions, so no fixed write rule handles both. We therefore formalize memory robustness as handling both without doing worse on other inputs. Since accuracy checks only the answer, we measure robustness with evidence-conditioned accuracy (ECA), which also checks that the records the manager selects include all the evidence the answer needs, updated and free of attacks. However, existing memory systems and defenses are not more robust than an untuned manager on our test sets. We improve robustness with a simple one-shot recipe that fine-tunes the manager on episodes synthesized around a single conversation with inserted changes and attacks. On three backbones, it improves every category score on our test sets and more than doubles the untuned manager's overall ECA, though robustness remains incomplete.

papers.title_en: Reglos: A Self-Evolving Personal Memory Agent with Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.authors: Sen Yang, Jiaduo Lin, Zehong Huang, Wen Liu
papers.evidence: 具有自演化记忆机制的个人记忆智能体
papers.tldr: 个人智能体依赖历史对话维护用户记忆，但现有系统让编码智能体重写记忆到上下文的harness，补丁易只修复目标失败案例而过度拟合。Reglos是免训练的个人记忆智能体，用追加式用户记录和递归自我改进生成补丁，并由第二模型家族评审筛除基准作弊，冻结harness后用固定评估器决定接受。在相同骨干下，它超过Mem0、MemOS、EverOS，Qwen3.8-27B取得61.3%和84.0%，GPT-5.6 Luna取得57.5%和87.2%。
papers.abstract_en: Personal agents draw on past conversations to tailor their responses to each user. Their memory systems store and update what each user says, and coding agents now also rewrite the harness that turns this memory into the model's context. Such patches risk overfitting, because one tested only on the failures it targets can fix those cases and help nowhere else. We present Reglos, a training-free personal memory agent that tests whether harness changes help beyond the failures they were written to fix. Its self-evolving memory adds to each user's append-only record with every conversation, as new preferences supersede old ones and facts can be forgotten. Its harness improves through recursive self-improvement, in which a coding agent proposes patches from failure traces and a critic from a second model family screens each one for benchmark gaming. After the harness is frozen, a fixed evaluator decides which further patches to accept. With the same backbone behind every system, Reglos outperforms state-of-the-art memory systems such as Mem0, MemOS and EverOS, reaching 61.3% and 84.0% on PersonaMem-v2 and LongMemEval-S with Qwen3.8-27B, and 57.5% and 87.2% with GPT-5.6 Luna.

papers.title_en: ZeroRAG: Adaptive Semantic Peer Routing for Decentralized Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Petru Neague, Quinten Stokkink, Martijn de Vos, Rafael Pires, Mathis Randl, Anne-Marie Kermarrec, Johan Pouwelse
papers.evidence: 去中心化检索增强生成与文档索引
papers.tldr: 现有RAG多依赖集中式文档库，难以满足隐私、版权与合规下的文档托管需求；去中心化检索又常引入协调者或全局结构。ZeroRAG是无全局数据结构的语义路由层，文档留在各peer，仅用邻居广告和查询缓存执行最佳优先游走，并逐步重连覆盖网络。在三个真实负载上，其召回率与消息开销优于两个去中心化基线，接近集中式存储的召回和LLM答案准确率，还能在节点大规模故障后自愈并扩展到10万peer。它为合规场景提供了可扩展的自组织去中心化RAG检索方案。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a standard approach to enhance the reliability of large language model (LLM) outputs by retrieving documents relevant to a query and supplying them in the LLM prompt. Today's RAG systems collect, index, and serve these documents from centralized stores. In practice, however, documents are owned by organizations, devices, and individuals who cannot or will not surrender custody of them to a central party, e.g., because of privacy, copyright or regulatory compliance. Existing modern decentralized retrieval techniques either reintroduce a coordinating authority, or rely on a global data structure that requires continuous network-wide coordination (e.g., DHTs). We present ZeroRAG, a decentralized routing layer for document retrieval in RAG that performs semantic query routing across an overlay of peers with- out global data structures or centralized orchestration. Documents remain with the peers that own them, and each peer keeps only lightweight local state: a bounded set of neighbor advertisements and a cache of recently routed queries. Using these, ZeroRAG steers each query through a best-first walk that progressively rewires the overlay toward semantically relevant neighbors, so recall improves over time as the network self-organizes. We evaluate ZeroRAG using three real-world workloads and two decentralized baselines. We find that ZeroRAG outperforms baselines in terms of recall and required network messages, approaches the recall and LLM answer accuracy of a centralized document store, self-heals after catastrophic peer failures, and scales to 100 000 peers.

papers.title_en: ArcadeDB in Python: An In-Process Multi-Model Database
papers.evidence: 内嵌多模型数据库引擎集成向量嵌入相似度检索
papers.tldr: Python工作流常需同时处理文档事务、图遍历和向量相似搜索，但现实常拆分多个系统并靠应用代码同步。ArcadeDB是支持这三类访问模式的多模型数据库，作者推出arcadedb-embedded，通过JPype和wheel内置JRE在Python进程内嵌入运行，免安装Java。查询结果可转为Python列表、NumPy数组、pandas DataFrame或Arrow表，并演示向量检索、SQL过滤与图遍历串联的混合流程。论文还与SQLite、DuckDB、LadybugDB、Chroma基准对比并报告开销。
papers.abstract_en: Some Python workflows need transactional reads and writes over documents, traversals over a graph, and similarity search over vector embeddings. In practice these are split across separate systems (a document store, a graph engine, and a vector index), and the data is copied between them and kept consistent by application code. ArcadeDB is an open-source multi-model database engine, written in Java, that supports all three access patterns and can be embedded in a host process. We present arcadedb-embedded, a Python package that runs ArcadeDB inside the Python process via JPype, using a Java Runtime Environment bundled in the wheel. One pip install gives a database with documents, a property graph, and vector search, and needs no Java installation. Query results can be returned as Python lists, NumPy arrays, pandas DataFrames, or Arrow tables. We demonstrate a hybrid retrieval workflow that chains vector search, SQL filtering, and graph traversal over one dataset. We benchmark arcadedb-embedded against SQLite, DuckDB, LadybugDB, and Chroma, and report its costs.

papers.title_en: Probabilistic Relevance Decisions for Semantic Retrieval
papers.evidence: 稠密嵌入语义检索评估
papers.tldr: 语义检索中，稠密相似度便于复用语料表示，而概率相关性决策可提供查询相关评分，二者如何结合仍需实证。研究在BEIR SciFact的300条官方查询上，以相同正例富集100文档池和全库稠密检索为协议，比较BGE-M3、TypeSafe Jev Noul与OpenAI决策分数，并在候选深度50和100重排。结果显示Jev的Recall@5与nDCG@10最高，深度50全库nDCG@10分别为0.6413、0.7545和0.7805；深度增至100仅小幅且不确定提升。该探索性分析支持相关性决策作为稠密检索补充，但未证明普遍优越、概率校准或深度等价。
papers.abstract_en: Dense similarity supplies reusable corpus representations, while probabilistic relevance decisions offer query-dependent document scoring. We compare dense-only BGE-M3 with TypeSafe Jev Noul and OpenAI Decisions Predicate scores on the official BEIR SciFact test benchmark. The study evaluates 300 official test queries using identical positive-enriched 100-document pools and full-corpus dense retrieval followed by reranking at candidate depths of 50 and 100. Unlike the controlled pools, neither dense prefix receives positive injection. Jev has the highest observed Recall@5 and nDCG@10 under the evaluated conditions. At depth 50, full-corpus nDCG@10 is 0.6413 for BGE-M3, 0.7545 with OpenAI and 0.7805 with Jev. Extending depth from 50 to 100 increases known-positive candidate recall but produces small, uncertain final-effectiveness changes. All four paired-bootstrap depth intervals include zero. Unique-condition API scoring cost approximately doubles, while compatible cached decisions reduce incremental expenditure. OpenAI returns many exact-zero scores, and secondary exact-tie randomization reveals ranking sensitivity without replacing deterministic primary results. Top-100 latency mixes cached and new execution. Historical hybrid latency is a saved-component sum under different execution environments and timer boundaries. These exploratory, unadjusted analyses support relevance decisions as a complement to dense retrieval within this protocol, without establishing general superiority, probability calibration or equivalence between depths.

papers.title_en: Enhancing Local and Global Structure in Compressed AI Agent Memory
papers.evidence: 面向AI智能体记忆的嵌入向量压缩与近邻保持
papers.tldr: AI代理将文本存为嵌入并压缩，但现有评估只看近邻保留，忽略远距结构，导致主题漂移。作者用局部保真度L和全局保真度G双端评估，证明近远排名违规率可约束全局结构。提出局部感知量化LAQ，把该界转化为OPQ码本上的合页目标，不改变字节、旋转与搜索。实验在52次留出运行中全部提升G，并在Multi-Doc-2025等任务上优于等大小量化器。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents store text as embedding vectors and compress them at scale. A compression is accepted when each item's nearest neighbors survive, but agents also consolidate, delete, and compare memories, tasks that depend on which items lie far apart. We evaluate both ends with two label-free fidelities from our prior work: the local fidelity $L$ at 10 neighbors and the global fidelity $G$ at 30 to 50 percent of the memory. At 96 bytes per passage, rescored binary codes reach an $L$ of 0.97 yet move 10.1 percent of passages to another theme; PCA with 8-bit codes, at an $L$ of 0.77, moves 1.7 percent. Rescoring leaves the stored codes, and thus $G$, unchanged. We prove that across the $G$ band, $1-ν_k$ is at most 2 to 2.18 times the square root of the near-far rank-violation rate, and that this rate follows the distance noise of the compression (correlation 0.979). Our locality-aware quantization (LAQ) turns the bound into a hinge objective on the codebooks of an OPQ index, keeping its bytes, rotation, and search. To our knowledge, LAQ is the first quantizer whose objective comes from a proven bound on the far end. Reconstruction alone raises $G$ in 0 of 52 held-out runs; the far hinge raises it in all 52. LAQ raises $G$ in all 52 ($p=8.5\times 10^{-4}$ over 13 memory-encoder groups), including the external FinDER memory, has the highest $G$ of seven equal-size quantizers in all 12 Multi-Doc-2025 runs, scales to a million passages, and keeps evidence recall.

papers.title_en: Pulse: Long-Horizon Tasks Need Streaming Personalization
papers.authors: Qijia Zhuang, Jialiang Liang, Yuxiang Ren
papers.evidence: 长期记忆智能体监控执行并检索用户与项目记忆实现个性化
papers.tldr: 长程多步任务需要持续个性化支持，但现有记忆增强智能体主要依据初始请求检索和使用记忆，对执行过程中的新需求感知不足，容易忽略用户偏好与项目约束。Pulse 提出流式个性化方法，用独立轻量记忆智能体持续监控执行，识别新出现的个性化需求与偏好冲突，并借助用户和项目记忆在合适阶段定向干预；强化学习进一步优化干预时机与方式。在 π-Bench 与 MCP-Persona 上，Pulse 分别取得 71.9% 和 46.4%，总体得分领先对比方法，同时提升任务执行效率。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly undertake complex, long-horizon tasks that benefit from sustained personalized support through long-term memory. Existing memory-augmented methods retrieve and use memory primarily from the initial request, with limited awareness of ongoing execution and emerging personalization needs. Agents may therefore overlook user preferences and project constraints during multistep tasks. We propose Pulse, a streaming personalization method for long-horizon tasks. An independent, lightweight memory agent continuously monitors execution, identifies emerging personalization needs and potential preference conflicts, and uses user and project memories to provide targeted interventions at appropriate stages. Reinforcement learning optimizes when and how the memory agent intervenes, improving the timeliness and accuracy of personalized support. Pulse scores 71.9% on $π$-Bench and 46.4% on MCP-Persona, achieving the highest overall scores among the compared methods on both datasets while improving task execution efficiency.

papers.title_en: Reducing Representational Interference in Retrieval Embeddings with Trainable Prefix Tokens
papers.authors: Seongtae Hong, Youngjoon Jang, Jungseob Lee, Chanjun Park, Heuiseok Lim
papers.evidence: 可训练前缀令牌改善用于语义搜索的检索嵌入
papers.tldr: 检索嵌入将变长文本压缩为定长向量，但可能把语义与 attention sink 等残留的 token 级信息纠缠在一起。作者在训练时于输入前加入可训练的 [DUMP] 前缀 token，不改变模型结构、池化方式和对比损失，仅用标准检索目标优化这些前缀。在标准检索与长上下文基准上，该方法在编码器和解码器嵌入模型上均稳定优于微调基线，并改变低信息 token 的激活与注意力模式。这表明可训练前缀是一种轻量且有效的检索表示改进手段。
papers.abstract_en: Embedding models compress variable-length text into fixed-size vector representations, but this compression can entangle semantic content with residual token-level information, such as artifacts arising from attention sink behavior. We propose a simple method that prepends trainable [DUMP] tokens to the input during embedding model training. The method keeps the model architecture, pooling strategy, and training loss unchanged, while optimizing the added tokens through the standard contrastive retrieval objective. By introducing trainable prefix positions that interact with regular tokens during encoding, [DUMP] tokens help reduce the influence of residual or uninformative token-level signals on the final retrieval representation. Experiments on standard retrieval and long-context benchmarks show that our method consistently improves over finetuned baselines across encoder and decoder embedding models. Further analysis shows that [DUMP] tokens alter token-level activation and attention patterns associated with low-information tokens. These results suggest that trainable prefix tokens provide a lightweight way to improve retrieval representations.
